obernants.observation_scope: One helper transition or explicitly finite scan trace
obernants.operator: For fixed dependency states and terminating scan traces, candidate inner absent behaviors include accepting f=100,b=0, taking more than per_round rules in a round, and running rounds+1 reports without early stop but claiming only rounds reports: loop is inclusive 0..=rounds. Source-inspected only; memory stop-gain and prior decision letter alter stopping/round count.

obernants.assumptions: Candidates have a first class atom and target within nearest three matching POS words. scan admission requires f/(f+b)>=0.8 and f>b+100. Pre-application counts and the heuristic noninterference predicate do not prove realized joint gain. Malformed trees/overflow excluded.

Saved bytes omit per-word heads, rejected candidates, decision lists and store query/version. Scan transformations.tsv omits fix/break counts. Thus output is not a unique training checkpoint; retain lexical collisions and latent state. Proposed equal-aggregate corpus oracle unexecuted.

obernants.observation_scope: One helper transition or explicitly finite scan trace
obernants.operator: Fixes arise at wrong non-root heads with k<=3 gold targets and no candidate cycle. Breaks count correct non-root heads with a different candidate target without the same cycle check. Top 2000 by fixes precede break scoring. Exact-real eligibility is f>=4*b and f>b+100, but Rust uses f64. Sort net gain, condition-count, Tr order, then greedily reject same first atom OR same(head,dir). This does not establish global best or realized gain. Proposed shortlist/tie fixtures unexecuted.

obernants.operator: save writes report.txt then transformations.tsv using ordinary fs::write. Second-write error can leave a new report with stale/partial transformations. Saves follow agreement, early-stop text, learned rules and final exit. Success yields final strings; no atomic pair, fsync durability, replay loader or complete checkpoint follows. stage.note/decide also affect external state. Proposed injected second-write error not executed.

obernants.operator: scan checks count>=limit once per acquired book, then adds the whole local batch; limits may overshoot. Completion order controls data append and first-encounter class IDs under mutexes, altering data[::20]. Determinism is conditional on fixed ordering/dependencies. Resource preimages retain W,N,T,F,C,threads and I/O rather than inferring corpus size from wall time. Current bounds uncalibrated; no runtime benchmark.
